cumulative_upstream_equivalents.meaning: The fork two-commit tip and upstream squash have identical entire trees, despite unequal stable patch IDs.

local_app_context.head: edec6c7ca3642ec2e9adce6d7680d2a8b8e5dd31
scope_notes: Current STORIES.md overrides the historical INTEGRATION.md acceptance.
S-025 Spotlight and presentation pointer are done.
S-015 presentation shortcuts are user assigned.
Undo/redo, annotation tools, capture, toolbar visibility/movement, local automation and two motion methods already exist.

raw_evidence.note: Cache is outside the working repository. JSON in the repository preserves repo IDs, every tip, complete per-branch reachable SHAs, ancestry, patch IDs and commit metadata even if raw cache is later removed.

future_delta_method: Enumerate and paginate forks recursively from the root, then all branches for every public repository. Key repository identity by GitHub numeric ID; record renames separately.
Fetch all branch histories into an external bare object database, freeze exact API tip SHAs, and verify every current branch with git ls-remote --heads.

Subtract all currently upstream-reachable SHAs, then compare against covered_all_shas_ever. Compare stable patch IDs against both upstream and historical patch groups; inspect squashes/rebases and inherited fork changes.
Retain historical covered SHAs and first_observed_at when a branch disappears or is rewritten. Report authored dates separately from observation dates.
Classify our own fork separately and compare recommendations with the current uncommitted Sources/TinyHand and current backlog.
